name: Prepared mustard, mayonnaise and salad dressings

Pb.binding_scope: Condiments excluding spices (tiao wei pin, xiang xin liao lei chu wai); includes soy sauce, compound/blended condiments, and edible salt (GB 2762-2022 Table 1, Lead; Appendix A.1)

other_form.scope: Vegetable oils, crude (oils of arachis, babasu, coconut, cotton seed, grape seed, maize, mustard seed, palm kernel, palm, rape seed, safflower seed, sesame seed, soya bean, and sunflower seed, and palm olein, stearin and superolein and other oils but excluding cocoa butter)

Vegetable oils, edible (oils of arachis, babasu, coconut, cotton seed, grape seed, maize, mustard seed, palm kernel, palm, rape seed, safflower seed, sesame seed, soya bean, and sunflower seed, and palm olein, stearin and superolein and other oils but excluding cocoa butter)

Cd.binding_scope: solid foods in general except categories with particular limits

other_form.scope: Vegetable oils, crude (oils of arachis, babasu, coconut, cottonseed, grapeseed, maize, mustardseed, palm kernel, palm, rapeseed, safflower seed, sesameseed, soya bean, and sunflowerseed, and palm olein, stearin and superolein).

Vegetable oils, edible (oils of arachis, babasu, coconut, cottonseed, grapeseed, maize, mustardseed, palm kernel, palm, rapeseed, safflower seed, sesameseed, soya bean, and sunflowerseed, and palm olein, stearin and superolein).

iAs.rationale: No sovereign inorganic-arsenic ML exists for these condiments; total arsenic is governed at 1000 (Vietnam 'Sauce'). Inorganic arsenic is controlled by reflex speciation on any elevated total arsenic.
iAs.reference_method: Total As by ICP-MS; reflex iAs speciation (HPLC-ICP-MS) on any total-As exceedance.

MeHg.rationale: No methylation pathway and no fish source in a seed/oil/egg condiment.

Ni.rationale: No sovereign nickel ML exists for these condiments, but mustard is a brassica seed and mayonnaise and vinaigrettes are oil emulsions that carry any nickel from the oil fraction (residual hydrogenation catalyst in a hardened component). Held under a reflex screen.
Ni.reference_method: Total nickel by ICP-MS on each lot; monitored under ALARA against the tightest available food nickel context.

Cr.rationale: No sovereign total-chromium ML exists for these condiments; the only food chromium MLs in the register are dairy. Rebuttable and audited each build.
Cr.reference_method: Total Cr by ICP-MS screen; reflex Cr(VI) speciation on any total-Cr exceedance.

Cr-VI.rationale: Hexavalent chromium is never a panel number for a food; it is the reflex-speciation species. Any total-chromium exceedance is speciated, and any quantifiable Cr(VI) fails.
Cr-VI.reference_method: IC-ICP-MS Cr(VI) speciation on any total-Cr exceedance.

Sn.rationale: Tin migrates only from tinplate cans; these condiments are sold in glass or plastic, not tinplate. No non-canned tin pathway exists.

Al.rationale: No sovereign aluminium ML exists for these condiments and no aluminium pathway operates. Rebuttable and audited each build.

method: HMTc Method v2.0 (government-limit default; face value, no reconstitution; read-across / control / not-material for unregulated cells; no occurrence percentiles)
lineage_note: Prepared mustard, mayonnaise and salad dressings are condiment SAUCES. Lead is governed by China GB 2762 'Condiments excluding spices' (Pb 1000; china_gb2762_pb_condiments_excl_spices_1000), which covers compound/blended condiments — stricter than the Vietnam QCVN 8-2 generic 'Sauce' Pb 2000. Cadmium is governed by the stricter Uruguay RBN general limit for SOLID foods (Cd 200; uy_rbn_general_cd_solid_foods_0_2mgkg), these semisolid emulsions being solid foods, binding below the Vietnam 'Sauce' Cd 1000. Total arsenic is the Singapore 'tomato ketchup and other sauces' finished-sauce value (tAs 1000, tied with the Uruguay solid-food general limit); total mercury is the Vietnam 'Sauce' value (tHg 50). Nickel is held under a seed/oil-derived screen (mustard is a brassica seed; mayonnaise and vinaigrettes are oil emulsions carrying nickel from the oil fraction). The register's mustard OIL (India vegetable-oils) and mustard GREENS (EU leafy) MLs are different product forms and are excluded from selection and downgraded in the audit.
